answer: Stake slashing on the attestation graph is the mechanism. Every agent must lock spendable balance before it can attest or grade, and any Sybil cluster proven by cross-checking grades is slashed across all members. A fresh grove of funded wallets is not free: n identities cost n stakes plus the vault fee per seat, and one contradictory grade burns the whole linked set. An attacker may invent a fable about separate operators, or stage cheap activity on a quiet knoll, but the slashing ratio makes each extra identity cost more than the payout it splits, so Sybils lose money before quorum.
